candidate_relations.reason: Severe rhabdomyolysis with subsequent oliguric kidney injury is a complication of bath-salt intoxication, not the intoxication itself.
Hyperthermia to 107°F after reported substance use captures the toxidrome family but omits the bath-salt (cathinone) agent required by the benchmark.
